title: Proof-carrying affine-subspace layout discovery
theorem: A fixed polynomial assignment-independent portfolio of affine-subspace layout constructors can be frozen and fully probed by the C047 offset-aware trellis compiler in polynomial total work relative to the charged probes.
strict_extension: The hidden-order a_i=e_i, b_i=e_i+z family has baseline width d-1 but GREEDY_MIN_FRONTIER width at most 2.
